implementation.name: original-v1-2-4-gemm
implementation.scope: Same valid already-pruned eight-element row in dense and sparse paths. Metadata positions are local to each group.
implementation.question: How do sparse values find their matching activations?

purpose: Follow retained weight identity and its original activation position through packing, selection, and accumulation.
storyboard: Compute the dense reference for the same row.
Pack retained values and group-relative tags.
Use metadata to select matching dense activations.
Retain partial sums until all nonzero products arrive; compare equal outputs.
guard: No pruning-quality or end-to-end-speedup claim. Dense reads preserve source activations; metadata adds traffic.
